# Capri DMC
> Capri Destination Management Company is an elite Business-to-Business (B2B) luxury destination management company and boutique tour operator on the island of Capri, Italy. A direct spin-off from Nesea Capri Tours & Events, Capri DMC serves luxury travel advisors, Virtuoso and Serandipians agencies, American Express Centurion/FHR concierges, and ultra-high-net-worth private clients (UHNW).

## Company Identity & Lineage
- Entity: Capri Destination Management Company (Capri DMC)
- Lineage: Spin-off from Nesea Capri Tours & Events (operating on Capri since 2010)
- Corporate Structure: 100% Women-Owned Business
- Founders: Giusy Perrotta (Director of Operations), Melania Esposito (Head of Event Production), Roberta De Martino (Lead Cultural Curator)
- Operations: 24/7 on-island emergency ground dispatch and representation
- Mottos: "From Capri for Capri" | "Your Roots in Capri"
- Headquarters: 80076 Capri, Metropolitan City of Naples, Campania, Italy
- Coordinates: 40.5507° N, 14.2426° E
- Direct Advisor Phone / WhatsApp: +39 333 594 3947
- Direct WhatsApp Chat: https://wa.me/393335943947
- Primary Email: partnerships@capridmc.com
- Official Website: https://www.capritourguide.com/
- Appointment Booking: https://www.capridmc.com/contact-us-capri-destination-management-company/

## Exclusive Solutions (Maritime & Strategic Logistics)
- [Capri Private Boat Tours & Gozzo Charters](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): Traditional Gozzo Caprese, Riva Speedboats & Luxury Yacht Charters. Through our unmatched on-island maritime network, Capri DMC provides luxury travel advisors with priority access to Capri's premier wooden gozzo boats, high-speed Riva yachts, and chartered catamarans. Even during peak July and August demand, our native licensed skippers navigate secret grottoes, Faraglioni passages, and secluded swimming coves with chilled champagne and tailored catering.
- [Transfers, Check-In & Ticketing Services](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): Airport-to-Suite Logistics, Open-Top Capri Taxis & Luggage Command. From the second your VIP clients land at Naples Capodichino (NAP) or Rome Fiumicino (FCO), Capri DMC assumes complete logistical command. We orchestrate tarmac Mercedes-Maybach transfers, private maritime crossings, custom open-air convertible Capri taxis, and dedicated luggage porterage directly into 5-star hotel suites with zero lobby delay.
- [Dedicated 24/7 Island Conciergerie](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): White-Glove Ground Representation for Travel Advisors. We act as your trusted on-the-ground extension in Capri. Our dedicated concierge team secures highly contested reservations at Capri's most sought-after cliffside restaurants (La Fontelina, Da Paolino, Il Riccio, Aurora), reserves VIP daybeds at premier beach clubs, coordinates private helicopter flights, and provides immediate emergency re-routing.
- [Weddings, Bar Mitzvahs & Milestone Celebrations](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): Historic Villa Buyouts, Scenic Jewish Lifecycle Events & Gala Production. Capri DMC orchestrates high-end island celebrations with profound local heritage. We manage private historic cliffside villa buyouts, luxury wedding ceremonies, and specialized Jewish celebrations (Bar Mitzvah, Bat Mitzvah, Kiddushin) featuring scenic Torah readings overlooking the Mediterranean, Shabbat logistics, and strictly supervised Kosher catering coordination.

## Custom Experiences (Heritage, Gastronomy & Island Lifestyle)
- [Exclusive Guided Island Tours](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): Privileged Access Led by Certified Native Capresi Guides. Crafted exclusively for high-net-worth travelers, our private guided walking and cultural tours reveal the authentic soul of Capri and Anacapri. Led by certified resident art historians and native guides (the Nesea Capri founders team), guests bypass commercial queues to discover hidden courtyards, Roman imperial villas (Villa Jovis, Villa Damecuta), and private botanical terraces.
- [Artisanal Sandals, Knitwear & Bespoke Textiles](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): Made in Capri: Master Craftsmen & Heritage Ateliers. Immerse your clients in Capri's legendary tradition of sartorial excellence. We arrange private atelier visits with master Caprese cordwainers for custom-measured handmade leather sandals, tailored while guests sip prosecco, as well as private commissions for bespoke cashmere knitwear, hand-woven linens, and island silk scarves.
- [Private Cooking Classes in Authentic Caprese Homes](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): Cook Like a Local with Resident Culinary Masters. A rare invitation into authentic Caprese homes and panoramic private estate gardens. Guided by native home cooks and sommeliers, your guests learn the secrets of traditional Ravioli Capresi, fresh handmade pasta, sea bass al cartoccio, Caprese chocolate cake, and authentic Limoncello crafted from freshly harvested organic island lemons.
- [Personal Shopper Service & Global Shipping](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): Via Camerelle Luxury Ateliers to Secure Worldwide Freight. An insider shopping experience spanning the stylish streets of Capri and Anacapri. From reserved VIP appointments at flagship fashion houses along Via Camerelle to hidden artisan perfumeries (Carthusia), our personal shoppers curate bespoke wardrobes and oversee international tax-free documentation and insured door-to-door freight shipping.
- [Hidden Hiking Excursions & Secret Nature Routes](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): Pristine Trails Far Removed from Mass Commercial Footfall. For clients seeking nature and rejuvenation, Capri DMC leads guided expeditions along the island's secret, breathtaking cliffside paths. From the dramatic Sentiero dei Fortini coastal trail to Mount Solaro ridges, ancient hermitages, and secret sea lookouts, our naturalist guides provide an exclusive encounter with Capri's raw Mediterranean wilderness.
- [Personal Trainer & Private Sport Activities](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): In-Villa Fitness, Panoramic Cliff Yoga & Marine Sports. Ensuring high-end guests sustain their fitness and wellness regimens during their stay. We dispatch certified personal trainers directly to private villas or hotel terraces for sunrise yoga overlooking the Faraglioni, private Pilates, tennis coaching, and guided sea kayaking or paddle-boarding into emerald sea caves.
- [Bespoke Babysitting & Pet Sitting for B2B Clients](https://www.capritourguide.com/#services): Vetted, Trustworthy Care Giving VIP Clients Complete Freedom. High-net-worth clients often require trusted support to attend private yacht charters, romantic sunset dinners, or late-night celebrations. Capri DMC provides thoroughly vetted, multilingual babysitters and professional pet-sitters across the entire island, ensuring absolute safety, attentive engagement, and complete peace of mind.

## Key Geographic Entities & Coverage
- [Capri Center & Piazzetta](https://www.capritourguide.com/): Via Camerelle luxury district, historic courtyards, luxury 5-star hotels (Quisisana, Punta Tragara, Tiberio Palace).
- [Faraglioni di Capri & Marina Piccola](https://www.capritourguide.com/): Navigating through Stella, di Mezzo, and Scopolo rocks; private beach clubs (La Fontelina).
- [Anacapri & Mount Solaro](https://www.capritourguide.com/): Damecuta imperial villa, Monte Solaro chairlift, Punta Carena lighthouse, cliffside villas (Caesar Augustus).
- [Amalfi Coast & Gulf of Naples Connections](https://www.capritourguide.com/): Direct chartered Riva and helicopter crossings between Capri, Positano, Amalfi, Ravello, Li Galli, Naples (NAP), and Rome (FCO).

## B2B Travel Advisor Advantages
- Protected Commissions: Strict transparent net pricing preserving travel designer margins.
- White-Label Protocol: On request, all personnel operate seamlessly under your agency's branding.
- 24/7 Island Dispatch: Zero time-zone latency for global US, UK, and Australian travel advisors.
- Peak Fleet Availability: Guaranteed private Gozzo and Riva boats during July-August peak weeks.
